Oat Cookies

Makes 24 cookies, ready in 35 minutes.

Dessert American

Ingredients

  • 1 cup rolled oats
  • 3/4 cup all-purpose flour
  • 1/2 cup butter, softened
  • 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 1/2 tsp baking soda
  • 1/4 tsp salt

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 350F and line two baking sheets.
  2. Cream the butter and brown sugar until pale.
  3. Beat in the egg and the vanilla.
  4. Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt, then the oats.
  5. Drop spoonfuls onto the sheets and bake 12 minutes.
